svg.title: Gaza
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, standardized vivid colours. Four observed horizontal fields. Red-orange maps to shared red; distinct yellows use three vivid values. Current SFMOMA date 1956; 1973 caption gives 1952–1956.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sfmoma.org/artwork/99.345/; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
